\subsection{\texttt{remove\_source\_ids}}
\label{method:feedback_intelligence_agent.vector_store.InMemoryVectorStore.remove_source_ids}\index{Methods!remove\_source\_ids}
Remove all chunks whose source document ID is in \texttt{source\_\allowbreak{}ids}.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
remove_source_ids(self, source_ids: set[str]) -> int
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{source\_\allowbreak{}ids}] \texttt{set[str]\allowbreak{}}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{int}
\apifield{Details}Returns the number of chunks removed. This supports incremental updates: a refreshed feedback record can replace every old chunk for the same \texttt{feedback\_\allowbreak{}id} before the new chunks are appended.

\subsection{\texttt{upsert\_sources}}
\label{method:feedback_intelligence_agent.vector_store.InMemoryVectorStore.upsert_sources}\index{Methods!upsert\_sources}
Replace existing source documents and append the new chunks.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
upsert_sources(self, chunks: list[DocumentChunk], vectors: npt.NDArray[np.float64]) -> int
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{chunks}] \texttt{list[DocumentChunk]\allowbreak{}}, required.

\apifield{Value}\texttt{int}. Number of chunks removed before adding the new chunks.
\apifield{Details}The replacement key is \texttt{DocumentChunk.\allowbreak{}source\_\allowbreak{}id}. All old chunks for any incoming source are removed first, which handles changed text that produces a different number of chunks.
